_comment_purpose: Single source of truth for critical-table classification used by the three guards in update.sh: validate_critical_tables (absolute floor), delta guard (vs source-snapshot), and the post-deploy smoke test. Adding a new critical table? Add it once here, not in three places.

_comment_fields.floor: Minimum row count below which the build aborts before deploy. Set to null for tables you want delta/smoke coverage on but no absolute floor.
_comment_fields.growth: 'incremental' = monotonically grows over time; any drop > 0.1% beyond noise is fatal in the delta guard. 'rebuild' = wiped+repopulated each run (e.g., DROP TABLE IF EXISTS + extract); 5% drop tolerated in delta guard.
_comment_fields.smoke: true = include in post-deploy smoke test (prod row count vs local). Keep this set small (~5 tables, top by row volume) since each table = one extra HTTPS round-trip to prod.
